parsed.name: DAQmx看门狗任务
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件任务对象，用于为 NI DAQmx 看门狗任务配置超时时间、过期触发条件，以及模拟输出、数字输出和计数器通道的过期状态。它通常用于 DAQ 设备或机箱的安全保护，在主机失联或看门狗超时时将相关通道切换到预设安全状态。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software task object for configuring an NI-DAQmx watchdog task, including timeout, expiration trigger conditions, and expiration states for analog output, digital output, and counter channels. It is typically used for safety protection on DAQ hardware or chassis, placing channels into predefined safe states when host communication is lost or the watchdog times out.
